SCOPE SPLIT 2026-09-28, and the former IDENTITY-DUPLICATION finding against the eczema identity is RETRACTED as erroneous at the evidence level. This identity is ATOPIC DERMATITIS specifically and is NOT a synonym for generic eczema; the two are deliberately NOT consolidated. This identity owns the atopic-disease route, whose registered edge is atopic-dermatitis-eczema -> asthma at IMMUNE_MEDIATED, the ATOPIC MARCH (J Am Acad Dermatol. 2022;86(2):365-372, PMID 34384834, qualified-human verified 2026-09-02), scoped to atopic dermatitis phenotypes and therefore NOT extendable to eczema in general. CROSS-REFERENCE: the generic and iatrogenic eczematous eruptions, including paradoxical eczema induced by biologic therapy for psoriasis, are owned by the sibling identity eczema in skin.json; a reviewer must not merge the two, and no claim routed here may be widened to generic eczema.
